candidateTailLimitLemma.claimLevel: priority-only conditional lemma; not accepted source evidence and not promotion evidence
candidateTailLimitLemma.statement: If the same retained sigma_eff, color-singlet envelope, branch-interface, and Noether sea response record supplies a uniform bound |Delta E_corr_NN(r)| <= C exp(-lambda(r-R0)) for r >= R0 with C>0 and lambda>0, and the corridor weight satisfies w_corr(r) <= C_w exp(eta(r-R0)) with 0 <= eta < lambda, then Delta_E_corr_NN_tail_limit follows: lim_R_to_infty T_NN(R)=0 and O_NN is finite.

proofSteps.derivation: For R >= R0, T_NN(R)=sup_{r>=R}|Delta E_corr_NN(r)| <= C exp(-lambda(R-R0)).
Because lambda>0, C exp(-lambda(R-R0)) tends to zero as R tends to infinity, so lim_R_to_infty_T_NN_R_eq_0 follows.
O_NN <= integral_R0^infty C C_w exp(-(lambda-eta)(r-R0)) dr = C C_w/(lambda-eta), so O_NN_finite follows when eta < lambda.

The accepted tail-limit row can feed finite_range_residual, same_record_no_open_color_audit, and no_open_color_far_field only after the same-record and accepted-upstream-row assumptions are also satisfied.
